title: invite kiyotaka into student council
context: Y1 Volume 4.5 final summer vacation episode. Later flashbacks and private narration do not imply global contemporaneous knowledge.

observed_result: Kiyotaka refuses; Manabu leaves the invitation open rather than forcing appointment.
